description: Rokid Glasses AIUI Agent - food safe: a leftover and fresh-food risk grader for when you cannot tell if something has gone off - register what you stored and when (name spoken verbatim or picked from presets, stored-date stepped back 0-14 days, fridge / freezer / room temperature), then check an item by reporting four things with your own nose, eyes and fingers (off smell, slimy surface, discolouration or mould, swollen packaging); the agent combines your reports with the real number of days stored against a clearly-labelled general storage-life guide and grades it THROW / CAUTION / RELATIVELY OK - it senses nothing itself, never calls food safe, and never replaces professional judgement
name: food-safe
